protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: CVE-2026-30226 is CVE.org state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn); vendor GHSA-cfw5-2vxh-hr84 withdrawn_at=null, CWE-1321. In v5.6.3 src/parse.js, parse() calls unflatten(); hydrate() takes the SPARSE branch when value[0]===SPARSE (-7), does const array=new Array(len) with untrusted len, then array[idx]=hydrate(value[i+1]) with untrusted idx. A key of '__proto__' therefore hits Array's inherited __proto__ setter (SetPrototypeOf), enabling prototype-chain DoS or type confusion. Regression payloads in 40f1db13afdd65c8e2ebd02f684276c273ef81b0 (e.g. [[-7,1,'__proto__',{}]] and the 49000-layer CPU-exhaustion construction) encode that source-to-sink. Parent object hydration already rejected plain-object '__proto__' keys; this hole is the new SPARSE assignment.
